title: Puppet Action Timeline
description: Timeline specification for Modern Archivist puppet character actions, expressions, eye states, and mouth movements. Time values are in seconds; fps is used for frame-accurate calculations.

version.description: Optional semantic version for the timeline format

fps.description: Frames per second for the timeline (e.g., 30)

tracks.description: Array of animation tracks specifying state changes over time

from.description: Start time in seconds. Must be less than 'to'.

to.description: End time in seconds. Must be greater than 'from'.

value.description: State value for this track. Must be a valid value in rig_spec.json states for the given type.
